purpose: Production-level Information Gain units. A unit is a page-specific, evidence-backed, non-boilerplate, non-substitution knowledge statement that is actually rendered on the page and useful to a governed audience. Units bind to EXISTING governed claims/evidence only; registering a unit never creates, approves, or locks a claim or source, and never changes publication state.

unit_schema.rule: No fact may be invented to reach the minimum. If governed evidence supports fewer than three units, the page is not publication-ready.

units.statement: The formula of molybdenum disulfide is MoS2, as recorded independently by the PubChem and NIST chemistry databases.
Bulk MoS2 is a layered material in which each layer is a three-atom-thick S–Mo–S stack.
In the 2H polytype, bulk MoS2 adopts the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a c-axis repeat near 12.3 Å.
Two independent determinations report the in-plane lattice parameter a of bulk 2H-MoS2 as 3.15(2) Å (Dickinson and Pauling, 1923) and 3.161 Å (Schönfeld, Huang and Moss, 1983).
The 3R polytype of MoS2 is a distinct structure with rhombohedral space group R3m and approximate lattice parameters a ≈ 3.17 Å and c ≈ 18.38 Å, so its values must not be attributed to the 2H form.
